rules.rationale: Source ESOL value prior for smiles_short was positive; small solutes pay a low cavity-formation cost in water.
Largest source negative value prior (smiles_long); extended apolar surface raises desolvation cost.
Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758); rigid ring systems reduced source solubility.
Rotatable-bond role maps to branching (transfer weight 0.758); limited flexibility lowers entropic solvation penalty.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL size, ring and branching value priors to hydration ranking, with slightly higher early semantic mass. May fail on seeds whose early reveals land in the large 506-item smiles_short bin, where the prior gives little discrimination.

rules.rationale: Joint small and acyclic solutes combine low cavity cost with high conformational simplicity.
Retains the best-supported source negative prior on molecular size.
Counter-hypothesis: downweights the low-confidence (0.159) donor-to-heteroatom role by mildly favoring apolar solutes.
Reverses the untested polar-dominance assumption; hetero_high covers only 28 sparse, chemically diverse candidates.

skills.hypothesis: Keeps size and ring structure as the primary axis while reversing the weakly supported heteroatom polarity relation. Fails if the hidden score truly rewards hydrogen-bonding capacity, in which case the heteroatom terms mislead early ranking.

state.lesson: Development seeds favored the source-grounded size/ring/branch prior (mean AUC 77.6) over the polarity-first prior (51.8), so the explicitly transferred value priors are the more reliable starting hypothesis; the mechanistic polarity argument remains unverified and is better tested as a downweighted counter-hypothesis than as deployment.
state.revision_summary: Retained the previously successful source-grounded skill with only small weight and semantic-mass adjustments, since its per-seed spread (53-99 AUC) reflects seed variance rather than a demonstrated flaw. Replaced the polarity-first skill, which underperformed on all eight development seeds, with a counter-hypothesis that keeps size and ring structure central while explicitly downweighting the lowest-confidence donor-to-heteroatom transfer role. Deployed the source-grounded skill.
